svg.desc: Two common-scale XYZ projections of the original and refined quarter_sheet Surface. Each blue evaluated grid contains 153 actual points. Orange and purple are the complete 3 by 2 and 4 by 2 control nets. U remains 2 to 7 and V remains minus 1 to 3. This is not GPU/editor output or a global shape certificate.
